statements.subject: session
statements.description: If the 'secure' flag is true, the Contact URI MUST be a SIPS URI.
statements.guard_semantics: dialog.secure = true → Contact URI must be SIPS URI

statements.subject: session
statements.description: The local sequence number is part of the dialog state; if not empty it must be incremented; if empty an initial value must be chosen.

statements.subject: session
statements.description: The route set is stored as part of the dialog state and is used by the UAC to build the Request-URI and Route header field of the request.

statements.subject: transaction
statements.description: If the local sequence number is not empty, the value of the local sequence number MUST be incremented by one, and this value MUST be placed into the CSeq header field.
actions: place new value in CSeq header field

statements.subject: transaction
statements.description: If the local sequence number is empty, an initial value MUST be chosen using the guidelines of Section 8.1.1.5.
actions: choose initial CSeq sequence number per Section 8.1.1.5
place value in CSeq header field

statements.subject: transaction
statements.description: If the route set is empty, the UAC MUST place the remote target URI into the Request-URI. The UAC MUST NOT add a Route header field to the request.

statements.subject: transaction
statements.description: If the route set is not empty, and the first URI in the route set contains the lr parameter, the UAC MUST place the remote target URI into the Request-URI and MUST include a Route header field containing the route set values in order, including all parameters.
actions: add Route header containing route_set values in order with all parameters

statements.subject: transaction
statements.description: If the route set is not empty, and its first URI does not contain the lr parameter, the UAC MUST place the first URI from the route set into the Request-URI (stripping non-allowed parameters), MUST add a Route header field containing the remainder of the route set values in order, and MUST then place the remote target URI into the Route header field as the last value.
actions: set Request-URI to route_set.first (strip non-Request-URI-allowed params)
add Route header with route_set.remainder values in order with all parameters
append dialog.remote_target_URI as last Route value
